'''Z-Eta Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of at least four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] that fought for the [[Zaarin coup forces|mutinous forces]] loyal to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] during the [[Second battle of Imperial Center]]. During the battle, several of the squadron's TIEs were destroyed by Imperial forces.<ref name="TIE fighter guide" />
